name: Earth Under Invasion
description: 98% of humanity vanished into a System-controlled tutorial space. The 2% who remain face three alien factions with conflicting agendas: the Vorath harvesters, the Shriven consciousness researchers, and the ancient Pale Court who built the System itself. Power grows through self-confrontation. Death births an inner demon. The System is doing something no one fully understands.

companion_system.label: Demon
companion_system.description: An inner demon that manifests after the player's first death. Born from their fears and failures. Not purely evil — it judges, teaches, and fights for dominance.
